help.goal: Answer more questions right than anyone else. One point per correct answer, best score wins.
steps: Read the question at the top of your phone.
Tap one of the four answer tiles before the countdown ends.
Wait while the right answer is revealed to everyone.
The next question starts on its own.
notes: You get 15 seconds per question and only one tap, so no changing your mind.
Answering late scores nothing, so guess rather than run out of time.
Bots can fill the empty seats. They do not peek at the answer — they simply know some questions and guess at the rest.
